scripts.build: pnpm --filter @contextual/extension build && pnpm --filter @contextual/local-host build && pnpm --filter @contextual/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/local-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/core/src/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/agents/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/drive/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/generation/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/jobs/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/storage/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/platform/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/lib/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/components/activity-items.test.ts apps/extension/src/video/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/native/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/i18n/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/i18n/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/*.test.ts && node --test apps/local-host/scripts/siri-download-journal.test.mjs apps/local-host/scripts/native-host-platform.test.mjs apps/local-host/scripts/pi-bundle.test.mjs scripts/host-entrypoints.test.mjs scripts/host-setup.test.mjs && pnpm test:package-manager && pnpm test:dev-config
scripts.web:deploy: pnpm web:build && node apps/web/scripts/build-cloudflare.mjs && cd apps/web && cf deploy --prebuilt
